text.en:
Registration of Criminals Act
(Chapter 268, Section 4(2))
Direction That Register of Criminals be Kept in Kuala Lumpur and Singapore
N 1
G.N. No. S 2046/1949
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
[22nd July 1949]
The Minister has directed that the register of criminals maintained in accordance with section 4 of the Act shall be kept at the Central Criminal Registry in Kuala Lumpur and that a subsidiary register shall be kept at the Criminal Record Office, Criminal Investigation Department, Singapore and these shall be kept in such manner as the Inspector-General of Police, Malaysia and the Commissioner of Police, Singapore shall respectively direct.
